description: This file contains helper functions for fetching and combining coding challenge data, including GraphQL queries, challenge merging, and error handling.

methods.name: queryGraphQL
methods.description: Performs a GraphQL query to the specified endpoint and returns the JSON response.

methods.name: fetchChallenges
methods.description: Fetches challenge data for a specified language ('javascript' or 'python') using GraphQL.

methods.name: combineChallenges
methods.description: Combines JavaScript and Python challenge data into a single challenge object, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by logging, closing the MongoDB client, and exiting the process.

methods.name: removeSection
methods.description: Removes the <section id="description"> HTML tags from a string.
